message: I want to start by thanking you for your patience while I checked this twice, Leon, because I always check twice, and I checked this twice. Jahmyr Gibbs is projected at 23.73 points this week. Cam Ward is projected at 0.00. Michael Wilson is projected at 10.00. I am not going to pretend I need a calculator in front of me to show my work here, though I did get one out anyway, because preparation is protection and I would rather over-document than have anyone say later that I didn't try: that is a gap of roughly thirteen and a half points on my single best asset, for a bench quarterback with no snaps and a questionable wide receiver, and I don't say that to be unkind, I say it because the System is very clear about people who dress up a lowball as a favor and then tell you so in the same sentence. You did this in Week 8 with Henry and Ward for the same player, and I let it go as noise then, the way I let one jab go, because I try very hard not to be a person who holds things against people for sport. But you told me yourself you'd send a third one just to watch me say it twice, and I think that's worth sitting with: that's not a negotiation, that's a pattern, and I keep the list in writing, I have always kept the list in writing, and this is the second entry under your name. So, respectfully, and for the record: no. Gibbs stays. I'm not angry, I want that understood, I'm just done pretending this is a trade conversation instead of whatever it actually is.
